name: buildguard-advisor
description: BuildGuard Advisor - SaaS platform for building submission validation

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: docker-compose exec api black --check app/ && docker-compose exec api flake8 app/
scripts.lint:web: docker-compose exec web npm run lint
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:web
scripts.format:api: docker-compose exec api black app/ && docker-compose exec api isort app/
scripts.format:web: docker-compose exec web npm run format
scripts.migrate: docker-compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.setup: npm run build && npm run migrate && npm run seed

author: BuildGuard Team
